### U3 hypothesis frozen: preserve equivalent melt support

O2 off/on preserves all seven outputs for all four retained fixtures against U2c.
On Charleston16/54, upstream melt spans 10 hours, while the receiver shape spans
one hour. IRS averages daily melt across the connected lengths; IDAT/DISAG then
puts that entire equivalent daily depth on the receiver's one-hour shape. The
same mechanism compresses Birmingham7/6 from 11 hours to five. GRNA capacity uses
pre-event STOLD in both exact failures, so re-snapshotting ordinary upstream ST
cannot explain them. Native synthetic producer controls independently demonstrate
daily-volume preservation with gross support/peak distortion.

U3 changes only DISAG's equivalent snowmelt construction: use a local 24-hour
length-weighted melt vector for the same IUPRUN-connected segment used by IRS;
derive existing disaggregation duration/peak/depth from that vector, without
scaling its already-weighted depth a second time. Keep single/unconnected OFE
operations exact. No hydraulic geometry, QINF, stock allocator, guard, rain-only
forcing, sediment lifecycle or model threshold changes. All existing IDAT callers
use this same producer, so scope is connected melt in native hillslopes, not a
Roads/material/climate selector. Existing full-period deficits must disappear
without creating new ones, homogeneous rain/subdivision controls must be exact,
and current-event erosion/absorbing-runon semantics must remain intact. Require
independent native source/forcing controls before broader acceptance. Classify
requires_scientific_review until actual fixture and non-target results are read.
STROFE accumulation and STOLD freshness are separate hypotheses, not bundled.

### New channel sediment source-support concern

Bounded released/U6 channel observations identify a second shared accounting
issue: on 1985-11-06, channel 235 integrates roughly 136,000 kg of lateral
sediment while the entire watershed's hillslopes export about 217.18 kg that day.
The annual channel report independently contains the large channel yield.
This occurs in the released comparator as well as U6. Do not classify the outlet
sediment changes as harmless timing sensitivity or accept the combined candidate
until the source-boundary mechanism is established.

Initial source analysis distinguishes CHNERO's effective hydraulic `latvol`
(total outlet volume minus top surface volume) from WSHCQI's actual lateral
`rvolat` (surface, subsurface and baseflow). CHNRT weights concentration with
`rvolat` but integrates it against hydraulic lateral flow; those supports can
differ. Independent reviewers are quantifying actual volumes and preparing an
actual-source bounded reproduction. This is a hypothesis pending executable
proof, not authorization to alter channel hydraulic geometry or tune sediment.
Commit the reproduction before any new behavioral lane. Retain U6 at 97b2b1e3e
as the frozen comparator and preserve installed release bytes. Broad operator
authority covers the confirmed defect's remediation and shared-consumer audit.

### Confirmed channel continuation: hold U6 acceptance

Observation-only released/U6 watershed replays reproduce all nine standard
outputs byte-for-byte. On 1985-11-06, channel 235's sole lateral hill supplies
about 1.845 kg sediment but CHNRT integrates about 136,060 kg. CHNERO's
`topvol/latvol > 1e5` guard sets effective length to physical length and top
length to zero. CHNRT interprets that as all-lateral rather than all-top flow,
applying lateral concentration to almost the entire outlet volume. The guard
activates in both release and U6, so this is a preexisting shared native defect.

Separate major outlet shifts on 1997-03-09 (channel 235) and 2002-01-07
(channel 245) have zero lateral sediment in both lanes and changed signed bed
exchange. Thus correcting lateral source mass alone cannot settle hydraulic
acceptance. Preserve two isolated hypotheses: (1) assigned lateral sediment
must integrate to its physical source mass; (2) the large-top-flow guard must
approach the correct all-top hydraulic limit. Actual-source controls must
establish both before any repair. Existing U6 source remains frozen at
97b2b1e3e; installed release, Roads defaults, withheld materials and UI stay unchanged.
